leads.notes: Boulder-based university press; publishes 40-50 titles per year in Western history, indigenous studies, environmental humanities, and anthropology. Reached at Senior Acquisitions Editor Michelle Chen, who joined in March 2025.

leads.title: Executive Editor
leads.notes: Boulder-based independent publisher founded 1969; produces 40-50 titles per year in Buddhism, Tibetan studies, meditation, and contemplative practice. One of the most respected names in Eastern spirituality publishing. Reached at Executive Editor Elizabeth Frankl.

leads.title: Acquisitions Editor
leads.notes: Minneapolis-based educational publisher founded 1983; produces 25-30 titles per year in social-emotional learning, self-help for teens, and classroom resources. Owned by Teacher Created Materials since 2021. Reached at Acquisitions Editor Deidra Purvis.

Reached at Acquisitions Manager Jon Graham.
